title: NASA's Sun fact sheet: mass, radius, and central temperature
summary: The sheet lists the Sun's mass, a Sun-to-Earth mass ratio of 332,900, a volumetric mean radius, and a central temperature.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists the Sun's mass as 1,988,400 × 10^24 kg, Earth's mass as 5.9722 × 10^24 kg, and the Sun/Earth mass ratio as 332,900. It lists a volumetric mean radius of 695,700 km for the Sun and a central temperature of 1.571 × 10^7 K. The v1 claims "99.86 percent of the system's mass," "diameter 1.4 million km," and "core temperature 15 million °C" are roundings in the neighborhood of these figures and are not copied as if they were the sheet. Use the sheet's numbers. Spectral type G2 V and the luminosity row are on the same sheet and are recorded on world.astronomy.sun-spectral-type and world.astronomy.sun-luminosity.
